# TUI slash commands

<!-- Generated by clients/tui/scripts/generate-commands-doc.ts; do not edit. -->

Built-in terminal commands, grouped by source module. Type `/help <command>`
in the TUI for live availability; some commands require daemon methods or UI hooks.
Aliases accept the same arguments as their command. `—` means no arguments or aliases.

Project-defined prompt commands are covered in [file slash commands](slash-commands.md).
See the [TUI guide](../../clients/tui/README.md) for keyboard shortcuts and client setup.

Regenerate from the repository root with `bun clients/tui/scripts/generate-commands-doc.ts`.

## approvals

## run

| Command | Aliases | Arguments | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| /abort | /stop | — | stop the run in flight |
| /queue | /q | [prompt] | queue a prompt, or show prompts waiting for the current run |
| /steer | — | &lt;prompt&gt; | send guidance into the active run |
| /redirect | — | &lt;prompt&gt; | replace the active run's pending direction |
| /retry | — | [--force] | retry the last failed or aborted turn (history-only rewind, then resend) |
| /runs | — | [count] | list active and recent runs |
| /goal | — | &lt;set &lt;text&gt; &#124; status &#124; pause &#124; resume &#124; clear&gt; | standing objective for this session |

## Global keybindings

These defaults come from the TUI global binding registry. Overlays own their keys;
editor and picker-local shortcuts are outside this table.

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| ctrl+o | Pick a model |
| shift+tab | Pick the session thinking level |
| ctrl+x | Switch session |
| ctrl+g | Edit the draft in $EDITOR |
| ctrl+l | Clear the transcript |
| ctrl+q | Edit the queued prompts |
| ctrl+r | Expand/collapse the latest tool card or thinking block |
| ctrl+t | Cycle detail for every card: collapsed → expanded → default |
| ctrl+p | Search commands, skills and prompts |
| alt+a | Show/hide live subagent tree |
| alt+m | Show/hide omp delegate sessions |
| alt+o | Collapse/expand all tool output |
| alt+d | Inspect the latest edit diff |
| alt+shift+c | Copy the last assistant reply |
